name: profile-build-check
summary: For data work. Profile the dirty data first, build the pipeline, then check the numbers in an independent way.

roles.name: data-analyst
roles.job: Profiles the data. Finds every kind of dirty value and maps each one to a rule in the spec.

roles.name: builder
roles.job: Writes the pipeline and its tests.

roles.name: checker
roles.job: Calculates the key numbers again with a different method and compares them.

steps.do: Read the spec and scan the data. List each kind of dirty value with examples and the rule that handles it.
Write the pipeline and tests for each rule.
Recalculate totals and counts in a separate script. Compare with the pipeline output. Send differences back.

rules: The checker must not reuse the pipeline code.
Each spec rule must have a test.
